scope: Source boundaries for unfinished Empire State child credit and NYC income-tax elimination credit; these pins do not claim implementation or approval

sourceClauses.location: New for 2025; General information; qualifying child and tie-breaker lists
sourceClauses.effect: The 2025 Empire State child credit is decoupled from the federal child tax credit. Its independent qualifying-child definition does not require an actual federal dependent claim. Retained unclaimed potential qualifying children therefore require review before a known zero child credit or state settlement.

sourceClauses.location: General information, first and second eligibility bullets; effective date
sourceClauses.effect: NYC income-tax elimination credit begins 2025 and requires one or more claimed dependents on IT-201 item H orIT-203 item I. No claimed dependents is an exclusion for this credit; adult claimed dependents still count.

primaryReferences.observed: The current enacted statute independently defines qualifying children and tie-breakers for 2025–2027; no federal dependency-claim condition is in that definition.
primaryReferences.verification: Read official statute through web reader on 2026-11-13. Direct original-byte retrieval was unavailable; no bytes or SHA256 are claimed for this reference.

limits: The annual instruction PDFs are the original-byte evidence for these boundaries.
